title: The #1 reason stokvels go wrong #Stokvel
text:
Ask the financial adviser Warren Ingram what goes wrong in stokvels, and he says almost every problem comes down to one thing: "Nothing was written down." No rule for what happens if someone stops paying, who can leave, or how the payout works. And when the money sits in one person's own account, it's exposed to anything that happens to that person: theft, death, divorce or debts.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
